convert_linear_to_srgb: convert a linear RGB tensor or numpy array to sRGB color space using the linear2srgb function
convert_camera_to_linear: map a characterized camera color space to linear RGB using mapped2linear with a custom CCM and gamma
convert_tensor_to_image: convert a PyTorch tensor to a displayable RGB or jet colormap numpy image using tensor2image
create_image_grid: arrange a batch of image tensors into a labeled grid layout using make_image_grid
draw_keypoints_on_image: render colored keypoints onto a numpy image using draw_keypoints_with_color
